name: Mindfulness
description: Mindfulness word search puzzles gather present-moment English for adults and seniors — breath, pause, notice, settle, silence and gentle calm words — without medical claims, app brands or studio slogans. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays everyday and soft: inhale, exhale, ground, listen, soft and sky vocabulary many people already recognize from a quiet sit. This hub is the parent collection for Meditation and pairs well with Yoga, Journaling and Gratitude when you want a longer calm session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as unhurried as a held breath.
